headlines.text: US stock futures inch higher as traders await today's critical August jobs report, the last major data point before the Fed's September 16 rate decision.
Dow surges 624 points to its best day in a month after Fed Governor Christopher Waller signals he'd support holding rates steady this month.
September rate-hike odds tumble to roughly 50-50 from over 60% after Waller's remarks, even as Bitcoin tops $80,000.
Hewlett Packard Enterprise shares slide 5% despite a blowout Q3 earnings beat and raised FY26 guidance, as the CEO warns of tight memory-chip supply through 2028.
Oil holds near $95 a barrel, up about 8% for the week, as the collapsed Iran deal keeps the Strait of Hormuz disrupted.
Economists forecast August payrolls rebounded to around 53,000-56,000 jobs, a pivotal reading for the Fed's September 16 FOMC decision.
